name: The One That Got Away

angles.text: As a paladin, you know the danger of an active Scourge focusing crystal that can animate or strengthen the dead beneath the ground.
As a priest, you know unholy relics can corrupt the land around them if they are not recovered and cleansed promptly.

aliases: who gives the one that got away
quest giver the one that got away
faq.answer: Ephram Barbaro gives the request after hearing of your earlier efforts against cultists near the Naxxramas battle remnants.
faq.q: Who gives the quest The One That Got Away?

faq.answer: The fragment is a piece of a Scourge focusing crystal carried off by an escaped cultist. Ephram Barbaro says it still holds power that may raise the dead or strengthen them beneath Shadowvale.
faq.q: What is the focusing crystal fragment?

faq.answer: Ephram Barbaro's intelligence places the fragment beneath Shadowvale, where the fugitive hid it underground.
faq.q: Where is the crystal fragment located?

aliases: the one that got away meaning
faq.answer: The title refers to the cultist who escaped the clash near the Naxxramas battle remnants with an active shard of a focusing crystal.
faq.q: Who is 'the one that got away'?

aliases: what happens when you return the crystal
turn in the one that got away
faq.answer: When you return the fragment, Ephram Barbaro commends your speed and says it is time for his favorite part of handling the situation.
faq.q: What happens when you return the crystal to Ephram Barbaro?

aliases: prerequisites the one that got away
faq.answer: Ephram Barbaro says word travels quickly among the ranks. He has heard of your earlier work against cultists near the Naxxramas battle remnants.
faq.q: How does Ephram Barbaro know about you?

sections.body: After the clash with cultists near the Naxxramas battle remnants, word spreads among the ranks. Ephram Barbaro hears that one cultist slipped past the perimeter with an active piece of a Scourge focusing crystal. He seeks capable adventurers to find the fugitive.
sections.title: A Fugitive in the Shadows

sections.body: The escaped cultist fled into passages beneath Shadowvale. The fragment still holds necromantic power, and may raise the dead or strengthen hostile forces underground. Ephram Barbaro sends you to track it down and secure it before that power brings greater harm.
sections.title: The Threat Beneath Shadowvale

summary: Near Naxxramas's remnants, Ephram Barbaro seeks the cultist who escaped with a dangerous crystal fragment. The fugitive fled beneath Shadowvale, and its power may raise or strengthen the dead.
attribution: In-game quest text: The One That Got Away
